dhpak2.5:3.1: Ekasmiñhi divase thero pipphaliguhāyaṃ viharanto rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā
dhpak2.5:3.4: udakapathavīpabbatādīsu cavanake upapajjanake ca satte dibbena cakkhunā olokento nisīdi.
dhpak2.5:4.2: vihārena ajja mama putto kassapo viharatī”ti
dhpak2.5:4.3: dibbena cakkhunā upadhārento “sattānaṃ cutūpapātaṃ olokento viharatī”ti ñatvā
dhpak2.5:4.6: ajānāpetvā cavanasattānaṃ paricchedo kātuṃ na sakkā,
dhpak2.5:4.7: te jānituṃ tava avisayo, kassapa, appamattako tava visayo,
dhpak2.5:4.8: sabbaso pana cavante ca upapajjante ca
dhpak2.5:4.10: obhāsaṃ pharitvā sammukhe nisinno viya hutvā imaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak2.5:6.1: Tattha nudatīti yathā nāma pokkharaṇiṃ pavisantaṃ navodakaṃ purāṇodakaṃ khobhetvā tassokāsaṃ adatvā taṃ attano
dhpak2.5:6.2: matthakamatthakena palāyantaṃ nudati nīharati, evameva paṇḍito appamādalakkhaṇaṃ brūhento pamādassokāsaṃ adatvā yadā
dhpak2.5:6.3: appamādavegena taṃ nudati nīharati, atha so panunnapamādo accuggatatthena parisuddhaṃ dibbacakkhusaṅkhātaṃ
dhpak2.5:6.4: paññāpāsādaṃ tassa anucchavikaṃ paṭipadaṃ pūrento tāya paṭipadāya nisseṇiyā pāsādaṃ viya āruyha pahīnasokasallatāya
dhpak2.5:6.5: asoko, appahīnasokasallatāya sokiniṃ pajaṃ sattanikāyaṃ cavamānañceva upapajjamānañca dibbacakkhunā avekkhati passati.
dhpak2.5:6.6: Yathā kiṃ? Pabbataṭṭhova bhūmaṭṭheti pabbatamuddhani ṭhito bhūmiyaṃ ṭhite, uparipāsāde vā pana ṭhito pāsādapariveṇe
dhpak2.5:6.7: ṭhite akicchena avekkhati, tathā sopi dhīro paṇḍito mahākhīṇāsavo asamucchinnavaṭṭabīje bāle cavante ca upapajjante ca akicchena avekkhatīti.
